Q: How to build artificial dataset for simulation power calculation in simr R for between-within subject deisgn A: 
SELECT 
    u.name AS User,
    et.name AS Action,
    v.name AS View,
    w.name AS Workbook,
    e.created_at
FROM historical_events e
LEFT JOIN hist_users u 
    ON e.hist_actor_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN hist_views v 
    ON e.hist_view_id = v.id
LEFT JOIN hist_workbooks w 
    ON e.hist_workbook_id = w.id
JOIN historical_event_types et 
    ON e.historical_event_type_id = et.type_id
WHERE et.name = 'View View'
AND e.created_at > (now() - interval '1 month')
